Dear Sir:
On April 14, 1972, ten (10) copies of the Draft Environmental/Section 4(f) Statement concerning the above captioned Lincoln Highway improvement was transmitted for review and comment to the Deputy Assistant Secretary for Programs, U.S. Department of the Interior. The Section 4(f) land involved concerned the Roosevelt School property of District No. 170, Cook County, Illinois. In a letter dated July 12, 1972, Mr. W. W. Lyons, Deputy Assistant Secretary of the Interior, responded with comments on the Draft Environmental/Section 4(f) Statement, Ref: E3039, ER 72/473.
During our preparation of the Final Environmental Statement, a review of the status of the Roosevelt School property involvement was conducted by the Board of Education, District No. 170, Cook County, Illinois. I have attached a letter, dated August 30, 1974, from the Board of Education which documents the findings and determinations reached in their review.
In view of this determination by the Board of Education, it is our opinion that the use of the Roosevelt School property, as discussed in the Draft Environmental/Section 4(f) Statement, no longer constitutes a Section 4(f) involvement. Your review and opinion in this matter would be greatly appreciated.
